title: ROYALHITS_LIVE
tagline: Storage bucket + Video streaming platform. Its a mixture of both the textile buckets and the Livepeer API
description: This project combines the benefits of Textile Buckets to submit your files directly to IPFS and the easy way to stream with Livepeer. It is supposed to bring and alternative for a creator that not only wants to Stream but also save such streams for a later minting process of just because it is valuable to store them with immutability.
how_its_made: It is an IPFS hosted app (supported by Fleek) using Textile buckets as the base to upload file directly to the decentralised blockchain and providing an endpoint to host a live stream with either Video, Audio or both (depending of the capabilities of the creator using Live-streaming software).
